import pathlib,json
Q=pathlib.Path.cwd().parent/'review-packet'
o=json.loads((Q/'original-leaf-bindings.json').read_text()); ids={e['id'] for e in o}
cat=json.loads(pathlib.Path(json.loads((Q/'external-inputs.json').read_text())[0]['path']).read_text())
selected=[e for e in cat['entries'] if e['id'] in ids]
print('raw selected',len(selected),'sample',json.dumps(selected[0],indent=2))
p=json.loads((Q/'semantic-proposals.json').read_text())
for i in range(32,140):
 e=p[i]; print(i,e['catalogContract']['symbol'],e['catalogContract']['kind'], e['observationClauses'],'facet:',e['individualFacet'],'anchor:',e['sourceAnchor'],'access:',e['sourceExportAccess'])
